SOURCINGRECORD / Comparison spread

Make the comparison worth reviewing.

Bids Review is a proposed RFQ collection and comparison module. It gives procurement one documented view of supplier alternatives, commercial terms and the exceptions behind a recommendation.

DEMO — SYNTHETIC DATA

The total needs
its context.

SOURCE · COMPARISON · REVIEW

THE JOB / THE BASIS

How often does a lead-time difference change your shortlist?

For indirect procurement heads and category managers at midmarket companies with repeat tail-spend purchases.

INPUT

Permissioned competitive RFQs and supplier quotes.

OUTPUT / PROPOSED

A comparable quote table with source references and reasons for exclusions.

THE WORKFLOW

A specific job.
A visible review point.

Each step retains the source and the unresolved exception.

01

Collect permissioned responses

Keep supplier participation and the quote source attached to the event.

02

Compare the whole basis

Show quantity, specification, currency, freight, delivery and total cost.

03

Review the recommendation

A cheaper quote stays held when its delivery basis differs from the baseline.

LIMITS / INTEGRATION SCOPE

Controls that stay in view.

A proposed module is a bounded workflow, not a general-purpose autonomous agent. Source-to-pay mapping would be assessed within a permissioned pilot; no production integration is claimed.

  • No recommendation based only on headline unit price.
  • A supplier opt-out remains an exclusion.
  • Collection does not authorize autonomous supplier contact.
Read all controls

FAQ

Before you choose the module.

Is the lowest cost automatically the winner?

No. The fictional Juniper quote costs less, but its 30-day delivery differs from the prior 15-day basis and remains held.

Does the concept contact suppliers autonomously?

No. The initial scope is a permissioned closed-RFQ diagnostic followed by a supervised supplier-consented live test.
